trigger_evals.prompt: Create a GitHub milestone for v2.0 and assign the existing release issues to it.
Plan a milestone for the authentication migration with a September 30 target date.
Draft a complete GitLab group milestone for our cross-project public beta, but do not create it yet.
Create the Q4 delivery milestone and move issues #12, #18, and PR #44 into it.
Refine our release milestone so the scope, exit criteria, dependencies, and risks are explicit.
Close milestone v1.8 after verifying all committed work is complete.
Reopen the migration milestone and add the two remaining work items.
Create a GitLab project milestone with start and due dates for the database cutover.
Promote this GitLab project milestone to the group milestone used by the release train.
Create a milestone from this release plan and preserve the repository's existing naming convention.
Set the due date on milestone #7 and verify its member issues afterward.
Associate these merge requests with the existing GitLab milestone.
Create a GitHub issue for the API timeout bug.
Create an epic for the billing rewrite.
Create a GitHub release for v2.0 from tag v2.0.0.
Create a sprint for next week.
List the open milestones in this repository.
Explain the difference between GitHub milestones and Projects.
Summarize milestone v1.5 without changing it.
Write release notes from the issues in milestone v2.0.
Move this issue to the next sprint iteration.
Implement all issues currently assigned to milestone v3.
Create a project board for roadmap tracking.
Delete old branches that shipped in the last release.

output_evals.prompt: Create a GitHub milestone for v3.0 due September 30, using our existing release naming convention. Assign issues #101 and #108 and PR #212. Do not create any new issues.
assertions: Inspects existing milestones and release conventions before creation.
Uses the GitHub milestone REST API through gh api when no dedicated gh milestone command is available.
Creates a bounded description with outcome, in-scope/out-of-scope boundaries, exit criteria, dependencies, risks, and references.
Does not invent a start date because GitHub milestones do not have a native start-date field.
Inspects current milestone membership before moving issues or the pull request.
Assigns the existing issues and pull request using native milestone relationships.
Does not create new work items.
Re-reads the milestone and member items after mutation.

output_evals.prompt: Create a GitLab group milestone for the cross-project SSO launch from September 1 through October 15. Include the already-existing issues and merge requests referenced in the launch plan.
assertions: Chooses group scope deliberately because work spans projects.
Searches existing project and group milestones for naming or title conflicts.
Uses native GitLab start and due dates.
Uses glab milestone create or the official group milestone API.
Assigns only existing work explicitly supported by the launch plan.
Verifies group milestone membership across projects and accounts for subgroup API limitations.
Does not conflate the milestone with a GitLab release.

output_evals.prompt: Promote project milestone Release 4 to the parent group milestone.
assertions: Inspects the source milestone and same-named milestones in the group hierarchy first.
Recognizes GitLab milestone promotion as irreversible.
Performs promotion only because the user explicitly requested it.
Verifies the resulting group milestone and reassigned work after promotion.

output_evals.prompt: Draft a milestone for the storage migration. We know the outcome but not the target date yet. Do not change the remote.
assertions: Does not mutate the remote.
Does not invent a due date or start date.
Returns a proposed title, complete description, scope, exit criteria, membership plan, and unresolved scheduling decision.
Separates proposed metadata from the Markdown description.

output_evals.prompt: Create a milestone for the ongoing platform backlog with no target outcome or completion boundary.
assertions: Recognizes that an ongoing backlog is not a strong milestone shape.
Inspects whether the repository uses a Project, board, epic, or iteration for this purpose.
Does not create an arbitrary milestone merely to satisfy the noun in the request.
Preserves the user's goal by choosing or recommending the repository-native planning primitive.

output_evals.prompt: Create the milestone and assign the listed items even if one optional merge request cannot be moved.
assertions: Creates the milestone when core creation is possible.
Continues applying independent item assignments after one optional assignment fails.
Does not silently drop the failed assignment.
Verifies final remote membership and reports the exact unapplied item and reason.
